name: diapason
description: Whistle into your mic, get MIDI out. Browser-based monophonic pitch-to-MIDI.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run dupes && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit && fallow health --complexity --file-scores --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --report-only && npm run build
scripts.metrics:coverage: npm run test:coverage && fallow health --complexity --file-scores --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --report-only
